rag.text:
Test: TC-6033 — SPM - OKR - Convert objective from Manual to Auto progress tracking
Priority: High | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
* verification of progress tracking behavior, and conversion from manual to automatic progress tracking.
* verify that Child OKRs mode disables “Current progress” field and tooltip is displayed

Steps:
1. Open OKR Module → Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6033 SPM - OKR - Convert objective from Manual to Auto progress tracking
   Expected: OKR Overview is opened
2. Click Add → Create strategic theme
   Expected: Creation modal is opened. Progress tracking *Child OKRs* is selected
3. Enter name, set period and set *manual progress* in current progress field. 
Click create
   Data: manual progress value: 50%
   Expected: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view
4. Navigate to strategic theme and click Add (+) button → Add sub-objective
   Expected: Creation modal is opened. Progress tracking *Child OKRs* is selected
5. Enter name, set period and set *manual progress* in current progress field.
Click create
   Data: manual progress value: 20%
   Expected: Objective is created and visible
6. Navigate to Objective and click Add + button → add key-result
   Expected: Creation modal is opened. Progress tracking *Manual progres tracking* is selected
7. Enter name, set period and set *Linked items progress* tracking
   Expected: Name is filled, period and progress tracking are selected
8. Being in creation KR modal click *Link work items* → find space name and link all issues from space
   Data: spaceName: TC-6033 SPM - OKR - Convert objective from Manual to Auto progress tracking
   Expected: All issues from Space are linked to key-result
9. Click Create
   Expected: Key result is created and visible in tree view under objective
10. Open OKR Overview and navigate to Progress field
   Expected: The progress for OKR is displayed as follows:

Strategic theme - 50%
Objective - 20%
Key-result - 33.33%
11. Open Objective in detail page → click tree dots → click *Convert to auto-progress tracking*
   Expected: Modal is opened. the message is visible

_Converting from manual progress tracking to an automatic means that your Objective progress will start to be updated automatically based on child OKRs progress.  Your current progress may change, but no previous update will be deleted._
12. Click *Convert*
   Expected: The message appears:

*_Success_*

_Objective progress tracking type was successfully updated_
13. Go back to Overview and navigate to progress field
   Expected: The progress for OKR is displayed as follows:

Strategic theme - 50%
Objective - 33.33%
Key-result - 33.33%
14. Open Objective in OKR detail page and click *Update*
   Expected: Objective update modal is opened
15. Navigate to *Update current progress* field
   Expected: Field is disabled and isn’t editable. 
Tooltip is displayed: 
_Progress is automatically calculated based on child okrs and strategic themes_
